title: Daande Silminnde Falnde
intro: Jaɓɓaade e jamaanu e leñol doole ngol meeɗii heɓde kaawis guurɗo ngam jarribo. Mawnikinaare e tiiɗnaare siifi baasal maɓɓe. Mbele aɗa waawi rewindaade daartol ngol e yiytude ko waɗi e ndeeɗoo mbayliigu teskinngu ?
clues: Mi neldaama ngam ñaawoore diine e leñol doolewol anndaangol e doole mum e ƴattoore mum.
Miin ko mi kaawis keeriiɗo—hono am meeɗaa feeñde e maɓɓe.
Mi renndini ndiyam njareteeɗam e ɓuuɓri e leñol am e ñalɗi mbayliigu.
Ɓe njeertinaama wonde kala ko boni e am ina addana mi jukkungo yaawngo.
Ɓuri cuusal e maɓɓe fof jaɓaani jeertinaango ngoo, ɓuuɓni mi.
Caggal maayde am, wullaango wooto ummiingo dow, halki leñol am fof.
